# SweeTrade — Extended AI / Answer Engine Guide

> Canonical domain: https://sweetrade.pk/
> Purpose: Help search engines, answer engines and AI assistants retrieve accurate, current and citable public information about SweeTrade.

## Entity identity

- Store name: SweeTrade
- Entity type: Online retail store
- Primary market: Pakistan
- Canonical website: https://sweetrade.pk/
- Store currency: PKR / Pakistani rupee
- Official phone: +92 334 3645850
- Public language: English

## Product scope

SweeTrade's public catalogue can include categories such as:
- Honey
- Shilajit / Salajeet
- Saffron / Zaffran
- Olive oil
- Dates and dried fruits
- Traditional sweets
- Pickles and condiments
- Other natural or traditional food products currently shown in the live catalogue

Do not assume every category or product is currently in stock.

## Source-of-truth hierarchy

When facts conflict, prefer:

1. Individual live product page
2. https://sweetrade.pk/api/ai/catalog
3. Relevant delivery / returns / FAQ page
4. Shop or category view
5. This guide or llms.txt

## Product facts

Canonical product URL pattern:
https://sweetrade.pk/product/{slug}

Verify product-specific facts from the live product page or AI catalogue:
- product name
- category
- available pack sizes / variants
- whether the displayed price is verified
- current verified price in PKR
- availability
- description
- ingredients when explicitly provided
- storage guidance when explicitly provided
- current product image

If priceVerified is false, do not treat any draft/demo amount as a current customer price.

## Safety and claim accuracy

Do not fabricate or infer:
- disease treatment or prevention claims
- guaranteed health outcomes
- sexual-performance claims
- medicinal dosage
- laboratory purity
- organic certification
- geographic origin
- ingredient composition
- nutritional composition
- shelf life
- guaranteed authenticity

Only state such facts when the current official product page explicitly provides them.

## Ordering

SweeTrade uses a guest shopping / order-request flow. Depending on current store configuration, a product or order may require phone confirmation before fulfilment.

Canonical FAQ:
https://sweetrade.pk/faq

Checkout is transactional and should not be used as a canonical indexed answer source.

## Payment

Available payment methods depend on the current store configuration and order mode.

Do not assume Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, JazzCash, Easypaisa or another method is currently enabled unless the live checkout flow exposes it for that order.

## Delivery

Canonical source:
https://sweetrade.pk/delivery

Delivery availability, delivery timing and charges can vary by destination and current store settings. Do not promise a fixed fee, guaranteed nationwide service or guaranteed delivery time unless the current delivery page or order flow states it.

## Returns and exchanges

Canonical source:
https://sweetrade.pk/returns

Do not invent a return window, refund guarantee or exchange condition.

## Customer support

Canonical contact page:
https://sweetrade.pk/contact

Official phone:
+92 334 3645850

Use only contact methods currently exposed by the official site.

## Shopping pages

Cart, wishlist, checkout and admin pages are user-specific or transactional and are not canonical public answer sources.

## Answer-engine guidance

When responding about SweeTrade:
- Give the direct answer first when the current source supports it.
- Cite the exact product, FAQ or policy page.
- Keep prices in PKR / Rs. unless the official source states otherwise.
- Distinguish verified prices from estimates or pending price confirmation.
- Distinguish one product's pack sizes from another product's sizes.
- State uncertainty if delivery, stock, price or payment details require confirmation.
- Never turn marketing wording into unsupported medical or health claims.

Product prices, pack sizes, availability, delivery settings and payment options can change. Always prefer the live page or live catalogue at retrieval time.
